title: Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow - Underground Melodies
description:
Ported by request (not familiar with the series). 12 custom samples (19.3KiB), works with #default.

Not being familiar with the series, I tried hard to think of something to tag it with (based on how I interpreted it), but all I could come up with was 'puzzle' and 'difficult'.

Update 190915: New organ, added oboe and harpsichord, minor tweaks/improvements (eg. 'Warm Pad' is now in the correct octave, drums are louder).
